name: Pane
text: Pane: A real API endpoint tonight risks burning dev hours on infrastructure we don’t need yet—it exposes real failure modes only after we’ve already locked in the wrong contract. Ship the thin live stub first, but instrument it with *real* latency percentiles from the real backend; that gives us the misalignment catch without the chaos tax.
